mapper.sql: id, source, name, COALESCE(biz_type, CASE content_type_id WHEN '12' THEN '관광지' WHEN '14' THEN '문화시설' WHEN '15' THEN '축제·행사' WHEN '28' THEN '레포츠' WHEN '32' THEN '숙박' WHEN '38' THEN '쇼핑' WHEN '39' THEN '음식점' ELSE '관광지' END) AS category, address, tel, latitude AS lat, longitude AS lng, use_time, rest_date, image_url, rating, review_count, amenities, map_url
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR biz_type ILIKE '%' || #{kind} || '%' ORDER BY
(latitude - #{lat}) * (latitude - #{lat}) + (longitude - #{lng}) * (longitude - #{lng}) COALESCE(review_count, 0) DESC, name
LIMIT 20

SELECT * FROM (SELECT , AS score FROM retrip_place WHERE latitude BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND longitude BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng}) p p.category LIKE '%' || #{category} || '%' ORDER BY p.score DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE name = #{name} OR name ILIKE '%' || #{name} || '%' OR (char_length(name) >= 3 AND #{name} ILIKE '%' || name || '%') ORDER BY (name = #{name}) DESC, COALESCE(review_count, 0) DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT FROM retrip_place WHERE address ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ORDER BY CASE WHEN source IN ('tour', 'sample') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, DESC LIMIT 60
SELECT content FROM retrip_review WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY LENGTH(content) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
